subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Rectification: AC to DC
description: A 60-second lesson on Rectification: AC to DC.

hook.text: Your phone charger takes AC from the wall and outputs DC. Rectifiers do the conversion.

buildup.text: A half-wave rectifier uses one diode to block the negative half of each AC cycle.

discovery.text: A full bridge uses four diodes to flip the negative half positive. Smoother output.

twist.text: Even after rectification, the output is bumpy. A capacitor smooths the ripples.

climax.text: Every laptop, phone, and LED light has a rectifier and filter inside its power supply.

punchline.text: Four diodes and a capacitor turn AC into DC — everywhere.

quiz.question: What does a full-bridge rectifier do?
options: Converts DC to AC for power transmission
Uses four diodes to flip both halves of AC into positive DC
Doubles the voltage of an AC signal
